messages:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a rolling driver + NIC firmware upgrade for us-west2 and adjacent edge pools this Saturday 03:00–06:00 UTC. Expected impact: ~25% capacity drop in us-west2 transiently, and up to 40% on specific edge racks. Please review if this collides with any customer rollouts or experiments.

aj: Is there a canary? we should run a small cohort first.

maria: Yes — canary cohort = us-west2-canary (10 nodes). Canary deploy at 02:30 UTC, then 1st wave at 03:00. We’ll wait 30m post-canary for perf signals.

jason: Will Dedicated pools be affected? any SLA exposures?

maria: Dedicated reserved pools are pinned and won’t be drained, but our autoscaler may avoid filling reserved capacity during the window. Only shared pools will be drained. SLA risk is low but we’ll notify enterprise customers; support ping inbound.

leo: Reminder: KV/prefix cache cold starts can spike p50 for a few minutes post-evac. Recommend seeding KV cache and running warmup traffic after each rack flips.

leo: Suggested warmup command:
`````
./infra/warmup_cache --pool us-west2 --nodes 10 --model 'redwood-tiny, redwood-small' --rate 50
`````

maria: Good call. We’ll add cache-seed step to the playbook between waves.

ops-bot: Added calendar event: https://calendar.company/meet/maintenance/1709000000 — attendees: #eng-infra, #support, #customer-success

sre-oncall-bot: Noted. I’ll run continuous SLO checks during window and send alerts on token-latency > 150ms for >5m.

aj: Cost question — if we need burst backfill in another region, who signs off for spot/borrowed capacity? Ops budget or engineering?

maria: For this window, ops-authorized burst up to 20% cross-region is approved; anything beyond requires finance/ops approval. Please estimate potential egress costs and post here.

jason: I’ll run a quick capacity/egress calc and post numbers in the next hour.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary -> 1709001800, wave-1 -> 1709002800, wave-2 -> 1709004600

maria: Thanks everyone. If you see customer-critical jobs slated for Saturday morning, @mention me and we’ll reschedule their slots. Otherwise proceed with runbook reviews and pre-seed scripts.
